summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems filed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 third amendment to its March 6, 2026 merger agreement with Gravitics, Inc., under which Merger Sub will merge into Gravitics, making Gravitics a wholly owned subsidiary. The amendment extends the outside closing and termination date from September 30 to October 30, 2026, raises the target public offering size from $40 million to $125 million, requires prompt Nasdaq uplisting, and removes affiliate-debt repayment and 10% dissent-share closing conditions. Watch the offering execution and financing risk.
